negroes.line: I'm twisted, blacklisted by some other negroes

negros.line: And I love Puerto Ricans and Negros
stanza: I cheered when Humphrey was chosen
My faith in the system restored
I'm glad that the commies were thrown out
And I love Puerto Ricans and Negros
As long as they don't move next door
